categories.name: Traditional Dishes
categories.description: Classic Ethiopian combination platters served on injera with a variety of stews and salads.

categories.name: Vegetarian / Fasting
categories.description: Plant-based dishes perfect for fasting days — rich lentils, split peas, and vegetables.

categories.name: Tibs
categories.description: Sautéed meat with onions, peppers, and berbere spice, served sizzling.

categories.name: Kitfo
categories.description: Minced raw or rare beef seasoned with mitmita and niter kibbeh — an Ethiopian delicacy.

categories.name: Firfir
categories.description: Shredded injera simmered with spicy berbere sauce and your choice of meat or vegetables.

categories.name: Breakfast
categories.description: Hearty Ethiopian breakfast dishes to start your day with warmth and spice.

categories.name: Drinks
categories.description: Traditional Ethiopian coffee, teas, and refreshing beverages.

categories.name: Desserts
categories.description: Sweet finishes to complete your Ethiopian dining experience.

dishes.name: Doro Wot Combo
dishes.description: The national dish of Ethiopia — slow-simmered chicken leg in fiery berbere sauce with hard-boiled egg, served with injera and side salads.

dishes.name: Vegetarian Combo
dishes.description: A colorful platter of misir wot, kik wot, gomen, atakilt, and shiro — five vegetarian stews on a bed of injera.

dishes.name: Sega Tibs
dishes.description: Tender cubed beef sautéed with onions, jalapeños, rosemary, and niter kibbeh, served sizzling on injera.

dishes.name: Kitfo Special
dishes.description: Hand-minced lean beef warmed in spiced clarified butter and mitmita, served with ayib cheese and gomen greens.

dishes.name: Beef Firfir
dishes.description: Shredded injera simmered in spicy berbere sauce with tender beef, served with fresh ayib cheese.

dishes.name: Shiro Wot
dishes.description: Smooth, creamy chickpea flour stew slow-cooked with garlic, onion, and berbere spice.

dishes.name: Kik Wot
dishes.description: Yellow split peas simmered in a mild, golden turmeric sauce with onions and garlic.

dishes.name: Misir Wot
dishes.description: Red lentils cooked in spicy berbere sauce — a fasting favorite rich in protein and flavor.

dishes.name: Gomen
dishes.description: Collard greens slow-cooked with garlic, ginger, and green chili until tender and aromatic.

dishes.name: Atakilt
dishes.description: A mild cabbage, carrot, and potato stew seasoned with turmeric and garlic.

dishes.name: Lamb Tibs
dishes.description: Succulent lamb pieces sautéed with onions, peppers, and rosemary in niter kibbeh.

dishes.name: Fish Tibs
dishes.description: Fresh tilapia sautéed with onions, tomatoes, and jalapeños in a light berbere sauce.

dishes.name: Key Wot
dishes.description: Cubed beef simmered in a deep red berbere sauce with onions and garlic until tender.

dishes.name: Kitfo Tibs
dishes.description: Minced beef lightly sautéed with mitmita, niter kibbeh, and herbs — a cross between kitfo and tibs.

dishes.name: Gored Gored
dishes.description: Cubed raw beef marinated in mitmita and spiced niter kibbeh, served with ayib cheese.

dishes.name: Vegetarian Firfir
dishes.description: Shredded injera simmered in spicy berbere sauce with onions and peppers — fully plant-based.

dishes.name: Kitfo Firfir
dishes.description: Shredded injera with spicy berbere sauce topped with seasoned minced beef.

dishes.name: Ful
dishes.description: Slow-cooked fava beans with onion, tomato, green chili, and a drizzle of olive oil.

dishes.name: Fata
dishes.description: Torn injera simmered in spicy tomato sauce with onions and berbere — a warming breakfast bowl.

dishes.name: Kinche
dishes.description: Cracked wheat cooked with niter kibbeh and onions — a comforting, mild Ethiopian porridge.

dishes.name: Ethiopian Coffee Ceremony
dishes.description: Freshly roasted and brewed Yirgacheffe coffee, served in a traditional jebena with popcorn.

dishes.name: Spiced Tea
dishes.description: Black tea steeped with cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves — warming and aromatic.

dishes.name: Tej (Honey Wine)
dishes.description: Traditional Ethiopian honey wine, naturally fermented and lightly sweet.

dishes.name: Sparkling Water
dishes.description: Chilled sparkling mineral water with a slice of lemon.

dishes.name: Dabo Kolo
dishes.description: Crunchy, lightly sweet roasted bites of wheat dough — a classic Ethiopian snack and dessert.

dishes.name: Honey Cake
dishes.description: Soft, moist cake sweetened with Ethiopian honey and a hint of cardamom.

dishes.name: Fresh Fruit Platter
dishes.description: Seasonal tropical fruits — mango, papaya, banana, and pineapple — beautifully arranged.
